body: character reference sheet T-POSE, straight-on front view -- a chibi voxel-block toy figure of a supreme royal knight-king, BOTH ARMS LOCKED COMPLETELY STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height like a scarecrow, elbows perfectly straight, a large visible gap between each arm and the torso, both blocky hands open with fingers spread, nothing held, fully visible in frame. UNMISTAKABLY CROWNED: a tall blocky gold crown block with at least 5 sharp spike-blocks worn directly on top of the head, the single most dominant silhouette feature. A black domino half-mask block (not a full helm) so the crown reads clearly. Large black blocky wing-shapes mounted flat against the back, made of angular feather-block layers, wider than the shoulders so unmistakable in silhouette. A gold scepter block strapped diagonally across the back (not held). A short black-and-gold cape block ending above the knee, stiff and short (not long or flowing). Big blocky head, short stubby blocky body, made of assembled rectangular blocks, every part flat with hard 90-degree edges, bold thick black outline stroke around every edge, flat hard-contrast shading. Legs straight, shoulder-width apart. Flat toy-voxel render style, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, generous empty margin so nothing is cropped, no text, no logos, no watermark
